item.title: Trump Signed Off on Iran Op After Netanyahu’s ‘Persuasive’ Pitch for Assassination Plot Revenge: Report
item.description: Intelligence had indicated the regime's leaders would be gathered in Tehran, creating an opportunity for a so-called “decapitation strike.”

item.title: Trump Appoints ‘Alpha Male’ Influencer Who Posts About ‘Boobs’ and ‘Beautiful Curvy Women’ to Serve as Special Presidential Envoy
item.description: Nick Adams, the "Alpha Male" influencer known for posting about his passion for Hooters, boobs, and "curvy women," announced he had been appointed by Trump.

item.title: We’re at War With Iran and Nobody Can Trust What Trump Says
item.description: The U.S. is at war with Iran, and Trump is making unverifiable claims about it — forcing allies, adversaries, and the media to react before truth catches up.

item.title: ONE SHEET: CNN’s Looming Cuts, From Radio Caller to Federal Policy, and Trump’s Mueller Death Diss
item.description: In today's one sheet we note looming cuts at CNN, how a radio caller's suggestion led to federal policy and Trump's death diss of Robert Mueller.

item.title: ‘I’m Not Working for You Hacks!’ Kara Swisher Vows to Leave CNN If the Ellisons Buy It
item.description: CNN's Kara Swisher vowed to leave the network if Paramount Skydance successfully acquires its parent company, Warner Bros. Discovery.

item.title: Trump Cast Vote by Mail Before He Called It Cheating
item.description: Trump voted by mail in a recent special election on Tuesday — the day after he called for an end to the practice that he branded "mail-in cheating."

item.title: US Citizen Released by Taliban After More Than a Year in ‘Near-Solitary Confinement’
item.description: Dennis Coyle, the Colorado man who had been detained by the Taliban for more than a year, has been released and will return home.

item.title: Trump Tells Local Anchor He Was Pals With ‘Elvis Has Left the Building’ Hotel Manager
item.description: President Donald Trump told a local news anchor he was friends with the hotel manager whose venue popularized the iconic phrase "Elvis has left the building!"
